result.summary: A team in white shirts attacks from right to left against a team in dark shirts. The viewer, in a white shirt, receives the ball centrally, drives towards goal, and scores with a shot from outside the penalty area.

observations.title: Direct run at the defence
observations.body: Receiving the ball in a central position, you immediately turn and run directly at the retreating defenders. Your positive first touch and acceleration into space create the shooting opportunity that follows.

observations.title: Shooting from distance
observations.body: As the defenders back away, you take the opportunity to shoot from outside the box. It is a decisive action, choosing to strike the ball early rather than attempting to beat the last defender or find a teammate.

observations.title: Shot results in a goal
observations.body: Your left-footed shot beats the diving goalkeeper and finds the back of the net. The play results in a goal for your team.
